name: SenderKit
description:
SenderKit is the messaging layer for AI agents and applications. One API sends 
transactional email, SMS, push, and web-push, and receives inbound mail back — 
so anything you build, from a background job to an autonomous agent, can reach 
a user and act on what comes back.

This connector puts that infrastructure directly in Claude's hands. Claude 
sends real messages on your workspace, writes and refines templates, and 
inspects what happened afterwards — then wires the same calls into your 
application when you're ready to ship.

What Claude can do:

- Send transactional & marketing messages across email, SMS, push, and web-push — from a saved template or with inline content
- Create, inspect, and regenerate templates from a plain-language brief, on 
any channel
- Provision inbound email addresses and custom inbound domains, then read the 
  mail that arrives — so agents can receive as well as send
- List sent and scheduled messages, filter by channel or status, and check 
  delivery detail for any individual message
- Cancel a scheduled or queued message before it goes out
- Confirm the connected workspace and whether sending is live or test
- Wire SenderKit into your own codebase — Claude can add the send calls, 
  template handling, and webhooks to your app

Typical uses: prototype a welcome email or OTP in conversation, then ship the 
same template call in code; debug a delivery that failed or stalled; audit 
what an agent sent last week; give a long-running agent an inbox it can read 
replies from.

SenderKit sends directly and can also route through providers you already run 
— Resend, SendGrid, Postmark, Mailgun, SES, SMTP, Twilio, FCM, APNs, Expo — so 
it fits in front of existing infrastructure rather than replacing it. Test 
mode simulates sends until you switch to live.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SenderKit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SenderKit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.senderkit.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SenderKit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SenderKit lists 18 MCP tools, including senderkit_cancel_message, senderkit_context, senderkit_inbound_addresses_create, senderkit_inbound_addresses_delete, senderkit_inbound_addresses_list, senderkit_inbound_domains_create, senderkit_inbound_domains_delete, senderkit_inbound_domains_list, senderkit_inbound_messages_get, senderkit_inbound_messages_list, senderkit_messages_get, and senderkit_messages_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SenderKit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SenderKit in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
SenderKit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SenderKit is developed by SenderKit. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
